set.body:
Files: a new tools/ci/collect_first_level_run_evidence.py (or shell wrapper plus pure parser), offline response fixtures/tests; inspect .github/workflows/first-level.yml and scenario-receipts.yml.
Steps: accept repository=canardlapin/scalafim, full candidate SHA and explicit run IDs. Use tools/github/gh-repo to fetch API run/job metadata and regeneration artifacts. Verify workflow identity, head_sha, terminal success, required jobs, attempt number, locked package revisions and actual generated fixture hashes. Emit P4.4d evidence JSON and raw response/artifact files with hashes. A success from a different SHA or old attempt must fail. Do not silently select the latest run by title.
Acceptance: offline parser tests for successful matching runs, wrong SHA/workflow/repository, rerun attempts, pending/failed/skipped jobs and missing/tampered regeneration outputs. On the admitted candidate, inspect or trigger only the required existing workflows when authorized, retain links and payloads, and verify the collector output using the pure validator. If remote credentials/workflows fail, retain the precise blocker; do not mark supplied URLs verified. Follow repo-local gh authentication, including authorized Keychain check before reauthenticating. No branch-policy changes or default-account changes.
set.title: P4.4f: collect candidate-bound CI and reference-regeneration evidence
